translation.name: Nzryrngrkxtr Kc Ate Rut x Sam

content.text: Yawe, xlrm nzkrka'-krnge,
Murde trxplrwxu x ninge ncblo txne.
Nim Gct rnge. Arlapx ninge mz nzbzngr murde tenge nim,
X ninge kxnzawz nem kc tqmnc-xgle-zvzle nim.
Nayc mz drtwrm ninge,
Murde vz zvz nzkrka'-krbo bam.
Kxetu rnge, aelalzm drtwrnge,
Murde abrtrpo drtwrnge bam.
Murde mrlz-esz'ngrn nzripq-zvzngr.
X aodu-zvzq krkcng tzkrka'bzng bam.
Yawe, lalztqm mz nzyrni-krnge,
X ayzlum natqnge.
Mzli ka kqlex nim mz nzkxpu-krnge,
Murde angidati-zvzme nzrlx-krbo da bam.
Kxetu, trpnz-moungr gct kx apule nim,
Murde trpnzngr nidr kx rkrlz nzalengr da kxnzkctipxng kcng tqale-zvzq.
Kxrpalz, lr drtc' amrlx kcng tqwz-ngrn
Sa nayrngzobzng bam mz nzarmyalz-krdr nim.
Murde nim txpwz Gct,
Kc tqmatq-esz'ngr mz nzale-krm rkx kxetuting.
Yawe, aelwa-ngrm bange me pnz drtwrm, murde navz-nqblqx natqm.
X alvztrp bange nzamrlue-zvz-krnge nim.
Murde nabznge atwrnrngr na-awibz bam mz nzngini-krm Gct x Kxetu rnge,
X na-angio-zvzx drtqm.
Murde nzaodu-zvz-krm ninge etu-esz'ngr,
Mz nzarlapx-krm ninge mz nzbzngr.
Gct, kxnzglqpx-lzbqng nztutitr nardr ninge.
Zbo ngr ncblo kxayo lc nzrpilr nanibqlr ninge, murde nzpxtxpx-ngrdr nim.
A' yc zvz mz drtwrm leplz, x zmrlz ngrm myalz-esz'ngr.
X drtwrm trngya-aniu, a' nzaodu-krm x nzangidati-krm tqvzpe tqvzpe.
Mz nzmu-krde lcde, yzlum x nayc mz drtwrm ninge.
Axplr x arlapx ninge, murde wztrpo bam da kc tqwai lxenge mz nzwztr-krbzle bam.
Yawe, okatrp ninge mz nivz lrm, murde drtq enqmi rngeng namyatx-zlwzng
Mzli kc namc-ngrdr nzaxplr-krm ninge x nzapqtr-krme drtwrnge.
